notes.title: Story writing in Stouthollow
notes.content:
[h1]The importance of story writing[/h1]
In the early stages of development we made a decision that the core mechanic of running the shop was the most important thing about the game. The second most important thing was the story. We have a story to tell and Stouthollow Tales is the medium through which we're telling it.

[h1]The process[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/0cf92008adfafcf79fb89b5c02e347541e8ad72e.png[/img]
The first stage of the story writing process is to open our big ol' google doc and write every single plot point out as a list or small description. This is super high level and just serves as a guide point. Items that appear in this doc are things like "Player inherits the shop." "Player repairs the mine."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/05ede8561394582cdb0badfac19935ad86d989f8.png[/img]
This method is a more recent addition but has been vital to the story writing process. We have a big flow chart with every quest in the game. Quests typically drive all content in the game, including the story. We're able to look at this flow chart and figure where everything falls into place. Which quest comes before and after another. It's really just a great way to organize your information and I highly recommend it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/fbc0f5333887a1fcbcc531c6a445fb4ef2c7df42.png[/img]

We implement the ideas into the game as quests and introduce new mechanics or use existing mechanics to support the new quest idea. An example of adding a new feature from story ideas was when we introduced the ability to plant and grow trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/1c1c171b5efca005017fc83c9f71f4c52fd46b72.jpg[/img]
The forest had always been an important place for us. The wood you got from chopping up logs is used in almost all crafting. In adding the carpenter's quest line, we added the forest management feature which really gave the carpenter's character a lot more depth.

As a side note another google doc is created for the actual scripts, the lines the characters will actually say in either dialog conversation or cutscene conversation. We do this for spellchecking reasons :P

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/764d3eb4261cc318211ebafa219caa1c61d121f1.jpg[/img]
Cutscene conversation adding depth to the plot.

We've been working on bringing a lot of the story together and trying to figure out where the plot goes, sot his is about as visual as we can get on an update for the game!

notes.title: What is Stouthollow Tales?
notes.content:
[h1]Who We Are[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/7dd61ba76d9866b787eeaaefd776681b58d3b81e.png[/img]
We are a 2 person development team, Whistling Alpaca Studio, working on Stouthollow Tales. We kicked around several ideas for a game we would love to make before we settled on creating an item shop game that we would want to play.
[h1]What is Stouthollow Tales?[/h1]
Stouthollow Tales is a JRPG style Item shop management game, driven by exploration, narrative, customization and collection.
[h2]Narrative[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/017a0ee110118f72a2e068f7920c659de193d2fb.png[/img]
Narrative plays a big part in Stouthollow Tales. The citizens of Stouthollow help drive the plot as you uncover the mysteries of the world around you.
[h2]Collection[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/a8cd098fb4cd50a7734f115c521a446f31cd12fd.gif[/img]
Stouthollow Tales has 9 (at time of writing) guilds who each have their own unique set of items and crafting recipes which influence other sections of the game in unique ways. For example, in order to upgrade your shop and craft new furniture you'll need to work with the Carpenter's Guild.
[h2]Explore[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/f681f27fe9f149c0c825eae9084ab6310cdca9ef.gif[/img]
The world in Stouthollow Tales is hand-crafted by us. Narrative feeds directly into finding new areas, meeting new people and discovering more about the world around you. Ponds, Rivers, Oceans and lakes contain many different fish (including legendary fish such as the Ancient Carp). Caves run deep under the earth, the deeper you go the more rare minerals you'll find.
[h2]Customize[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38319752/050c35818e9749047fced036ad2c954edd3ce074.gif[/img]
Make your store and your character your own. Customize your character's Hair, Clothes and skin tone as well as your store's furniture, floor and wall style!

Make sure to stay tuned to our social channels as well as this steam page in order to see updates for the game as the become available!

-Whistling Alpaca Team
